name: NextChat
setup: . scripts/env.sh && cd "$SRC" && rm -rf node_modules && HUSKY=0 YARN_CACHE_FOLDER="$RM/.tools/yarn-cache" "$RM/.tools/pm/node_modules/.bin/yarn" install --frozen-lockfile --non-interactive --cache-folder "$RM/.tools/yarn-cache"
notes: Node v24.19.0, local yarn classic 1.22.22 from $RM/.tools/pm (repo pins packageManager yarn@1.22.19; yarn.lock is v1). Setup: yarn install --frozen-lockfile with the yarn cache in $RM/.tools/yarn-cache; HUSKY=0 so the `prepare: husky install` script does not rewrite the copy's git hooksPath. Cold install ~58s (rt-client is fetched from a GitHub release tarball URL in package.json). test_cmd = the repo's CI command (`yarn test:ci` = node --no-warnings --experimental-vm-modules $(yarn bin jest) --ci) with `$(yarn bin jest)` replaced by ./node_modules/.bin/jest so no global yarn is needed; HOME/TMPDIR sandboxed into $ENV (jest's cache dir lives under TMPDIR). next/jest (jest.config.ts, jsdom) loads next.config.mjs/.env. 34 suites / 157 tests, all pure unit tests (model helpers, cloudflare URL rewrite, formatting, hmac, MCP json, storage); none touch the network or any LLM API, nothing deselected. Two runs: 157 passed both times (jest Time 1.34s/1.21s; ~3s wall). Console warnings from IndexedDBStorage in jsdom are expected noise. typecheck_cmd = strict tsc 5.2.2 over the whole project with --incremental false (tsconfig sets incremental:true, which would otherwise write tsconfig.tsbuildinfo and make later runs cache-dependent): exit 0, 0 `error TS`. No .next/types are present (no build run), which is fine for tsc.
